stories.title: Opening Night Five Days Away — Banner, LeBron, and the Finals Rematch

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Five days. The Knicks hang the banner. LeBron walks into MSG as the villain. The Finals rematch tips at 9:30.

October 20 can't get here fast enough. 🏀 #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
$2,200+. That's the going rate on the secondary market to watch LeBron debut with the Sixers at MSG on Oct. 20.

Knicks fans are paying it without hesitation. #NewYorkKnicks

stories.title: Roster Deadline Two Days Away — Lakers, Nuggets, Warriors Face Cuts

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
The NBA roster deadline is 48 hours away. Most teams are doing math.

The Warriors are doing something different — they don't know when their starting center will be healthy. #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Roster deadline roundup:
— Nuggets cut Lonnie Walker IV
— Raptors waived Trey Jemison (hand injury)
— Jazz waived Mohamed Wague
— Clippers signed Fletcher Loyer

Oct. 17 at 4 PM CT is when it all locks in. #NBA

Big problem. #GoldenStateWarriors

stories.title: The Knicks' Villain Tour Begins — How Every Arena Will Treat the New Champions

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text:
For one more night, MSG belongs to the Knicks.

After Oct. 20, every road game is enemy territory. Brunson's hero chapter closes — the villain tour begins.

#NewYorkKnicks

x_posts.label: Post 8
x_posts.text:
Lakers still have guaranteed-contract calls to make before Friday's 4 PM CT deadline.

They came into camp with 16 standard contracts. They need 15 by Sunday. The math isn't done yet. #NBA
